        target_dtype (dtype): target dtype of the output array.
    Returns:
        numpy_array (ndarray): converted numpy array.
    """

    assert len(target_shape) in (2, 3, 4)

    numpy_array = float_tensor.detach().cpu().numpy()
    
    # Reshape to target shape

            numpy_array = numpy_array.reshape(target_shape[1], target_shape[2], target_shape[3])

    numpy_array = float_tensor.detach().cpu().numpy()
    
    # Reshape to target shape
    if len(target_shape) == 2:
        # HxW - tensor is NxCxHxW, so we need to get the actual HxW
        # If tensor is 1x1xHxW, we want HxW
        if numpy_array.shape[0] == 1 and numpy_array.shape[1] == 1:
